main.label: Knockout, then recovery
main.explanation: A Warrior is knocked out ("You have been knocked out."), then recovers. The production pump clears the ignore flag. The original keeps ignoring all combat messages forever after the knockout: the recovery message queues nothing (buffer count stays 1). The corrected version, using the borg's own dont_react field (cleared by the pump, as upstream intended), resumes reacting: the recovery message queues (count 2).

native-c/dontreact-14: starting...
SETUPSTEP profile
SETUP seed=1000 class=Warrior
  knockout_flag_clears_on_pump  STATE after_baseline=1
STATE after_ko=1
STATE after_recovery=1
OUTCOME recovered=0
Failed
    native-c/dontreact-14:91: requirement 'after_recovery > after_ko' failed
native-c/dontreact-14 finished: 0/1 passed

no-knockout.label: Control: no knockout
no-knockout.explanation: The same baseline reaction, parse, pump and reaction sequence with an ordinary message ("You feel less thirsty.") where the knockout was. The knockout flag is never raised, so every reaction queues (1, 2, 3) in both versions.
